Nina (Finance): Received invoice from EireCloud Ltd (IE). They put 0% VAT (reverse charge) but emailed AP saying 'we expect gross-up since payments route via our US parent and US withholding will apply.' Can someone confirm approach?

invoice-bot: New invoice #EC-0099 1812345650 07/12/26 EUR 42,000 vendor VAT: IE3456789A

Caleb (Vendor Ops): Sounds like the vendor is mixing VAT and US withholding. Need to confirm billed legal entity and paying entity. If invoice is to Redwood Ireland and paid from EU, reverse charge is fine. If paid by Redwood Inc (US) they may be worried about backup withholding.

Oona (Tax): Short answer: we don't gross-up by default. Two threads: VAT and US withholding. For VAT: if invoice is addressed to Redwood Ireland with valid IE VAT and services sourced outside Ireland per rules, reverse charge applies. For withholding: if payment originates from our US entity and vendor claims US-source income subject to withholding, they must provide a completed W-8BEN-E and proof of foreign status. Also ask for tax residency certificate and the legal basis for gross-up in the contract (SOW/clause).

Ravi (Accounting): Invoice quick view:
```
Invoice: EC-0099
Date: 2026-07-11
Billed to: Redwood Ireland Ltd (VAT: IE9988776A)
Amount: EUR 42,000
VAT: 0% reverse charge (vendor VAT IE3456789A)
Payment terms: 30 days
```

Nina (Finance): Draft reply I'll send: "Please confirm which Redwood legal entity this invoice is issued to and where payment will be made from. Provide your Irish VAT registration extract, a statement of tax residency (or certificate), and if you expect payment from a US entity without withholding please attach a completed W-8BEN-E. We cannot gross-up without a contractual clause and a written gross-up calculation. Payment is on hold until these documents are received." Good?

Caleb (Vendor Ops): Add: ask them to reissue invoice to the correct Redwood entity if billed incorrectly. Also request a copy of the agreement or SOW line that mentions gross-up if they claim entitlement.

Oona (Tax): Also ask where the services were performed (IE vs US). If services performed in US, different sourcing could affect withholding. If they keep pushing gross-up, Legal needs to review before we agree.

invoice-bot: Payment hold placed: reason 'awaiting vendor tax docs / contract clause' 1812345699

Ravi (Accounting): I'll flag AP ticket and block payment until docs land.

Nina (Finance): Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll send the note and update when vendor replies.

Oona (Tax): One more: if they send both W-9 and W-8 like some vendors do, accept only the correct form based on declared residency. We'll advise after we see their docs.
